title.narrative: To reduce malaria incidence and deaths by at least 75 percent of the 2016 levels by 2023, working towards a malaria-free Kenya - Kenya (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Kenya, Malaria, Amref Health Africa in Kenya (Amref Kenya)This program has the following goals: To reduce Malaria Incidence and Deaths by at-least 75% of the 2016 levels by 2023. The objectives of this program are: To protect 100% of people living in malaria risk areas through access to appropriate malaria preventive interventions by 2023. To manage 100% of suspected malaria cases according to the Kenya malaria treatment guidelines by 2023. To establish systems for malaria elimination in targeted counties by 2023. To increase utilization of appropriate malaria interventions in Kenya to at least 80% by 2023. To strengthen malaria surveillance and use of the information to improve decision-making for programme performance. To provide leadership and management for optimal implementation of malaria interventions at all levels for the achievement of all objectives by 2023
